verses.gurmukhi: ੩ : ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਤੋਂ ਵਿਰਵਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਹੀਣਾ ਤੇ ਇਕੱਲਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 3 : manmukh gurmukh to(n) viravaa manmukh moorakh heenaa te ika'laa hai

en.bdb: The self-willed one is a fool, deprived and alone,   ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਅਖੀਂ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh ra(n)g na dhisiee ho(n)dhee akhee(n) a(n)nhaa soiee|

en.bdb: He who cannot see the grandneur of gurmukhs is blind despite his eyes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕੰਨੀਂ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh samajh na sakiee ho(n)dhee ka(n)nee(n) bolaa hoiee|

en.bdb: He ‘who does not understand the idea of a gurmukh is deaf despite his ears.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਈ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਜੀਭੈ ਗੁੰਗਾ ਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sabadh na gaaviee ho(n)dhee jeebhai gu(n)gaa goiee|

en.bdb: He ho does not sing the hymns of Gurmukh is dumb though having a tongue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਕਟਾ ਹੋਂਦੇ ਨਕਿ ਅਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval dhee vaas vin nakaTaa ho(n)dhe nak aloiee|

en.bdb: Devoid of the fragrance of the lotus feet of the Guru, he is supposed to be with a clipped nose (brazen-faced) despite his lovely nose.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕਰੀ ਲੁੰਜਾ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh kaar vihooniaa ho(n)dhee karee lu(n)jaa dhukh roiee|

en.bdb: A person devoid of Gurmukh's sense of service is a wailing cripple, his healthy hands notwithstanding and he goes on weeping.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਸਈ ਸੋ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨ ਲਹਂਦਾ ਢੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat chit na vasiee so mat heen na laha(n)dhaa ddoiee|

en.bdb: One in whose heart, the wisdom of the Guru is not sustained, is a fool who gets no shelter anywhere.
